summary: Tested web/PWA upgrade for Invite Studio. Backend smoke regression PASSES: GET /api/health → {status:ok, llm_key_configured:true, stripe_configured:true}; POST /api/payments/create-checkout-session returns cs_* session_id + checkout_url. HTML check PASSES: /<title>Invite Studio — Custom event invitations</title>, <meta name=theme-color content=#E26D5A>, <link rel=manifest href=data:application/manifest+json;...> with manifest JSON-decoding to {name:'Invite Studio', short_name:'Invites', start_url:'/', display:'standalone', theme_color:#E26D5A, background_color:#FAF9F6, icons:[...]}. Home responsive grid VERIFIED: @1920 → 4 cols (template-card-0..3 all y=348, centered with 380px left/right whitespace, maxWidth ~1160); @900 → 3 cols (cards 0,1,2 on row1; card 3 on row2); @600 → 2 cols (cards 0,1 row1; 2,3 row2). install-banner correctly NOT shown in headless Chromium (no beforeinstallprompt fired), no console crash. Editor @1920 VERIFIED: canvas wrap rendered at x=660, width=600 (centered via scrollContent maxWidth:640 + 20px padding); all 6 tool buttons (tool-text/background/color/font/layout/ai) + save-invite-btn present and tappable. Preview unpaid VERIFIED: locked-banner + pay-btn render. Service worker: navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations()=0, controller=false on both first AND second load — registration via blob: URL did not produce a registration that persisted, BUT inline registration code did not throw any console errors (try/catch wraps everything). save-gallery-btn label='Download' on web verified by static code review (preview/[id].tsx line 306: `const saveLabel = IS_WEB ? 'Download' : 'Save to gallery';`); could not seed a paid invite via localStorage in Playwright due to double-JSON encoding of AsyncStorage layer (storage.setItem stringifies, AND saveInvites passes JSON.stringify(invites) as the value — so raw on disk is double-encoded). Preview 2-column layout verified by code review (preview/[id].tsx: isWide=width>=900 → contentWide row layout, shotWrap flex:1.2 maxWidth:560, sidePanel flex:1).
action_items: Optional: investigate why the blob-URL service worker registration in app/+html.tsx does not produce a persistent registration on Chromium (getRegistrations returns []). Function does not throw, so PWA install criteria may still be met via manifest+secure-context heuristics in real Chrome, but a hosted /sw.js would be more reliable than a Blob URL (some browsers reject Blob-URL SW registrations for installability).

Optional (testing-only): expose a small testing helper or use a stable storage encoding so that QA can seed a paid invite via document JS without round-tripping through Stripe. Currently `saveInvites` double-stringifies (storage.setItem already JSON.stringifies, and saveInvites passes JSON.stringify(invites)) — confusing but functional.
critical_code_review_comments: preview/[id].tsx save flow on web correctly skips MediaLibrary and uses webDownload via a hidden <a download>; webShare gracefully falls back to download if navigator.canShare({files}) is false — looks good.

+html.tsx inline SW: registers a Blob-URL SW with empty fetch handler. This is fine syntactically and won't crash, but most browsers do not consider Blob-URL SWs valid for installability — Chrome historically required a same-origin SW script. Consider serving /sw.js as a static asset so Add-to-Home-Screen works on more browsers.

store/invites.ts saveInvites does `storage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(invites))`, and storage.setItem itself JSON.stringifies — leading to a double-encoded raw on disk. loadInvites correctly compensates by JSON.parse-ing the string a second time. Works but is brittle; consider passing the array directly so storage handles the only stringify.

useInstallPrompt: window event listener for beforeinstallprompt is attached at module top-level (outside the hook). If the module is imported after the event already fired (unlikely on first paint but possible on hot reload), the prompt is lost. Minor edge case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on requested flows (manifest/title/theme; 4/3/2-col responsive home; centered editor; preview unpaid). Paid-preview Download label verified via code review.

seed_data_creation: Tried to seed paid invite via localStorage; storage layer's double-stringify foiled it. No persistent test data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage layer in /app/frontend/src/utils/storage/index.ts auto-JSON.stringifies values. /app/frontend/src/store/invites.ts ALSO calls JSON.stringify before storing — net result: raw localStorage value is double-encoded JSON. To seed a paid invite from Playwright, write `localStorage.setItem('invite-maker:invites:v3', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify([invite])))`. The Save button label on web is hardcoded 'Download' (preview/[id].tsx line 306). isWide breakpoint for preview 2-column layout is width>=900.
rca_of_issue: No app bugs found. The 'preview never loads' observed during seeding was a test-rig artifact caused by single-encoded localStorage data not matching the store's double-encode expectation — not a product bug.
